key_insight: The paper extends virtual distillation from qubit systems to bosonic quantum processors, showing how multi-copy measurements can recover noise-mitigated expectation values for common bosonic observables.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical error-mitigation path for continuous-variable and photonic hardware using experimentally available linear-optical interferometers instead of full state purification.
method: Diagonalize cyclic shift operators with passive linear-optical interferometers.
Estimate virtually distilled values of number operators, phase shifts, and quadratures from multi-copy measurements.
Use the photon-number characteristic function to obtain higher-order correlators.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports application to photon-loss and dephasing noise, with quantified suppression of noise contributions in the recovered observables.
watch_item: The approach depends on access to multiple high-quality state copies and precise interferometric measurements, which may limit scalability under realistic loss and dephasing.
paper_title: Error Mitigation in Bosonic Systems via Virtual Distillation
